study type: In vitro mechanistic study with human tissue comparison
cohort: The study involved human placental tissue from preeclampsia and normal groups, as well as HTR-8/SVneo cells (human trophoblast cell line) and human umbilical vein endothelial cells (HUVECs).
finding: IL-6 levels were higher in the placenta of preeclampsia group, and IL-6 suppressed trophoblast cell proliferation and invasion while promoting HUVEC angiogenesis, indicating its role in regulating trophoblast function by interacting with multiple proteins and pathways.
cross-section timing: Placental tissue was analyzed at the time of delivery.
